_metadata.description: Roll one node or the fleet to a target revision; protocol-compatibility gating; auto-rollback on failed setup.

requirements.title: Remote Update, Version-Pin & Rollback
requirements.description: The control plane can roll one node or the whole fleet to a target revision, gate on node↔control-plane protocol compatibility before dispatching incompatible work, and automatically roll a node back to its prior revision if setup fails — keeping the fleet coherent without per-machine hand-maintenance.

validation.notes: A failed setup during an update restores the node's prior revision; protocol-incompatible nodes are flagged needs-update and excluded from dispatch.
A fleet-wide pin moves every healthy node to the target revision and reports per-node results.
